section_1_cloze.passage:
Artist Rogan Brown is known for turning delicate sheets of paper into impressive 3-D coral reef(珊瑚礁) sculptures. His work shows endless [41] of what can happen when art and conservation come together to raise awareness and inspire [42]. Coral reefs worldwide are being threatened by pollution and habitat destruction. [43] this, it's not unusual to find examples of coral bleaching(白化) among the reefs.
As a result, many of Brown's sculptures are based on [44] paper, which barely have bright colors we often [45] healthy coral reefs with. This provides much of his work with a [46] feeling as the viewer sees copies of pale, damaged coral. [47], some color does get into his work, but is often used to highlight the [48] between bleached and healthy coral.
The [49] going into Brown's pieces is undeniable. One can imagine how much time it must take him to painstakingly cut the shapes out of paper and the [50] that is needed to apply them to the larger sculpture. But the work is [51]. Each of his sculptures is so [52] that it's hard to believe we're not looking at images taken in nature. It reminds people to take action to [53] coral.
However, Brown's designs are not [54] to sculptures. Several years ago, at fashion designer Iris van Herpen's invitation, Brown [55] her to create several amazing dresses with coral designs.

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，Rogan Brown将纸张变成珊瑚礁雕塑，他的作品是艺术与环保结合能产生何种结果的“无数案例/例子（cases）”。A选项effects（效果，影响）虽有迷惑性，但在表达“……的例子”时，cases更符合此处语境（等同于examples）。易错点：误选A或D，忽略了作品本身就是融合艺术与环保的“具体案例”。
questions.supplement:
A(effects)：语境句：The medicine has no side effects on patients. 固定搭配：have an effect on, side effects
B(predictions)：语境句：The scientist made accurate predictions about the weather. 固定搭配：make predictions, accurate predictions
C(cases)：语境句：In some cases, students may need extra help. 固定搭配：in many cases, extreme cases
D(details)：语境句：Please pay attention to the details of the contract. 固定搭配：in detail, go into details

questions.explanation: 空前为raise awareness（提高意识），提高意识的最终目的是“激发改变（inspire change）”，即促使人们采取行动保护珊瑚。固定搭配inspire change意为激发变革。易错点：误选C，虽然激情（passion）也可被激发，但环保题材最终落脚点通常是采取行动做出“改变”。
questions.supplement:
A(wonder)：语境句：The child looked at the stars in wonder. 固定搭配：in wonder, no wonder
B(change)：语境句：We must take action to bring about positive change. 固定搭配：bring about change, inspire change
C(passion)：语境句：She has a strong passion for music and painting. 固定搭配：passion for, have a passion for
D(innovation)：语境句：Technological innovation is the key to economic growth. 固定搭配：technological innovation, encourage innovation

questions.explanation: 前句提到珊瑚礁受到污染和破坏的威胁，后句提到经常能发现珊瑚白化的例子。两者之间是因果关系，即“由于（Because of）”这些威胁，白化现象很常见。易错点：误选C，According to表示“根据”，不表示因果。
questions.supplement:
A(As for)：语境句：As for the plan, we will discuss it tomorrow. 固定搭配：as for me, as for the rest
B(Ahead of)：语境句：He finished the project ahead of schedule. 固定搭配：ahead of time, ahead of schedule
C(According to)：语境句：According to the report, the population is increasing. 固定搭配：according to law, according to the rules
D(Because of)：语境句：The match was cancelled because of the heavy rain. 固定搭配：because of this, just because of

questions.explanation: 根据后半句定语从句“which barely have bright colors（几乎没有明亮的颜色）”以及下文“sees copies of pale, damaged coral（看到苍白、受损的珊瑚）”可知，他使用的是“白色的（white）”纸张。易错点：脱离上下文主观臆断选B（特殊的）或C（废旧的）。
questions.supplement:
A(white)：语境句：She was dressed in a pure white gown. 固定搭配：white lie, in black and white
B(special)：语境句：You need special tools to open this box. 固定搭配：special occasion, special attention
C(used)：语境句：He bought a used car at a lower price. 固定搭配：used to do, get used to
D(colorful)：语境句：The festival was filled with colorful decorations. 固定搭配：colorful life, colorful clothes

questions.explanation: 句意：我们经常把明亮的颜色与健康的珊瑚礁联系在一起。固定搭配 associate ... with ...（把……和……联系起来）。易错点：误选A，compare ... with ... 是“比较”，不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(compare)：语境句：You shouldn't compare your child with others. 固定搭配：compare A with B, compare A to B
B(decorate)：语境句：They decided to decorate the room with balloons. 固定搭配：decorate... with..., beautifully decorated
C(surround)：语境句：The small village is surrounded by high mountains. 固定搭配：be surrounded by, surround oneself with
D(associate)：语境句：People often associate the color red with good luck. 固定搭配：associate with, be associated with

questions.explanation: 观众看到苍白、受损的珊瑚模型，这种环保灾难的展示会给人带来一种“严肃的/沉重的（serious）”感觉。易错点：误选A（好奇的），未能体会文章环保主题的沉重基调。
questions.supplement:
A(curious)：语境句：The curious boy asked a lot of questions. 固定搭配：be curious about, out of curiosity
B(serious)：语境句：The environmental pollution is a serious problem. 固定搭配：serious problem, take sth seriously
C(content)：语境句：She is quite content with her current life. 固定搭配：be content with, to one's heart's content
D(subjective)：语境句：Art evaluation is often highly subjective. 固定搭配：subjective opinion, subjective judgment

questions.explanation: 上文提到作品主要基于白纸，本句说“有一些颜色进入了他的作品”，说明颜色不是常态，而是“偶尔（Occasionally）”使用。易错点：误选B（自然地），未注意到前后文对比转折关系。
questions.supplement:
A(Hopefully)：语境句：Hopefully, we will reach our destination by noon. 固定搭配：hopefully wait, start hopefully
B(Naturally)：语境句：Naturally, parents want the best for their children. 固定搭配：come naturally, naturally occur
C(Occasionally)：语境句：We occasionally meet for a cup of coffee. 固定搭配：occasionally happen, visit occasionally
D(Obviously)：语境句：Obviously, he didn't prepare well for the exam. 固定搭配：state obviously, quite obviously

questions.explanation: 加入的颜色通常是为了突出白化的珊瑚（白）与健康珊瑚（彩色）之间的“对比（contrast）”。易错点：误选C（冲突），珊瑚之间不存在冲突，而是视觉和状态上的对比。
questions.supplement:
A(contrast)：语境句：There is a sharp contrast between the two cultures. 固定搭配：in contrast to, by contrast
B(interaction)：语境句：Language learning requires constant interaction with others. 固定搭配：social interaction, interaction with
C(conflict)：语境句：The two sides couldn't resolve their long-standing conflict. 固定搭配：in conflict with, resolve a conflict
D(relation)：语境句：The relation between diet and health is complex. 固定搭配：in relation to, international relations

questions.explanation: 下文提到要花大量时间煞费苦心地剪纸和拼贴，说明作品倾注了大量的“汗水/心血（sweat）”。这里sweat是比喻用法，代表辛苦劳作。易错点：误选B或C，虽然艺术品需要想象力和创造力，但紧接着的后一句着重强调了耗时和耐心，因此“汗水（努力）”最贴切。
questions.supplement:
A(pressure)：语境句：Students often face great pressure before exams. 固定搭配：under pressure, peer pressure
B(imagination)：语境句：Reading can stimulate a child's imagination. 固定搭配：rich imagination, beyond imagination
C(creativity)：语境句：The art class encourages children's creativity. 固定搭配：spark creativity, show creativity
D(sweat)：语境句：He wiped the sweat from his forehead after running. 固定搭配：blood and sweat, break a sweat

questions.explanation: 将小纸片应用到大型雕塑上需要极大的“专注力/注意力（attention）”。与前文的painstakingly（煞费苦心地）相呼应。易错点：误选D（支持），拼贴纸张需要的是集中注意力而非支持。
questions.supplement:
A(attention)：语境句：You should pay closer attention to your spelling. 固定搭配：pay attention to, catch one's attention
B(respect)：语境句：We should show respect for the elderly. 固定搭配：show respect for, out of respect
C(contribution)：语境句：He made a great contribution to the company. 固定搭配：make a contribution to, outstanding contribution
D(support)：语境句：I am grateful for your continuous support. 固定搭配：in support of, financial support

questions.explanation: 由But转折和后文提到“每件雕塑都栩栩如生……能提醒人们采取行动”可知，虽然耗时费力，但这项工作是“值得的（worthwhile）”。易错点：误选A或D，忽略了But带来的语意反转（辛苦但是值得）。
questions.supplement:
A(demanding)：语境句：Nursing is a physically and emotionally demanding job. 固定搭配：demanding job, demanding task
B(thorough)：语境句：The police carried out a thorough investigation. 固定搭配：thorough understanding, thorough investigation
C(worthwhile)：语境句：Volunteering at the hospital is a worthwhile experience. 固定搭配：worthwhile effort, make it worthwhile
D(complicated)：语境句：The instructions were too complicated to understand. 固定搭配：complicated situation, complicated process

questions.explanation: 后文说“很难相信我们看到的不是大自然中拍摄的照片”，说明雕塑非常“栩栩如生/逼真（lifelike）”。易错点：误选C（鼓舞人心的），虽然作品有教育意义，但这句具体强调的是外表的真实感。
questions.supplement:
A(classical)：语境句：She enjoys listening to classical music in her free time. 固定搭配：classical music, classical literature
B(lifelike)：语境句：The painter created a very lifelike portrait of the king. 固定搭配：lifelike statue, lifelike appearance
C(inspirational)：语境句：The coach gave an inspirational speech before the game. 固定搭配：inspirational quote, inspirational figure
D(heartwarming)：语境句：It was a heartwarming story about a lost dog finding its home. 固定搭配：heartwarming moment, heartwarming story

questions.explanation: 根据全文主题（艺术与环保结合），艺术品的目的是提醒人们采取行动去“保护（preserve）”珊瑚。易错点：误选C（恢复），recover作及物动词时通常指寻回、收复，preserve（保护、保存）更符合自然保护的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(identify)：语境句：The witness was able to identify the suspect. 固定搭配：identify with, clearly identify
B(explore)：语境句：They decided to explore the mysterious cave. 固定搭配：explore the possibility, explore nature
C(recover)：语境句：It took him a long time to recover from the illness. 固定搭配：recover from, fully recover
D(preserve)：语境句：We must take measures to preserve our cultural heritage. 固定搭配：preserve the environment, well-preserved

questions.explanation: 后文提到他还设计了有珊瑚图案的衣服，说明他的设计并不“局限于（restricted）”雕塑。be restricted to为固定搭配，意为“仅限于”。易错点：误选A，be applied to是“应用于”，not applied to意为“不应用于雕塑”，与事实相悖。
questions.supplement:
A(applied)：语境句：The new rules will be applied to all students. 固定搭配：apply to, apply for
B(restricted)：语境句：Access to the military base is strictly restricted. 固定搭配：be restricted to, highly restricted
C(attached)：语境句：She is deeply attached to her hometown. 固定搭配：be attached to, attach importance to
D(assigned)：语境句：The teacher assigned a lot of homework for the weekend. 固定搭配：assign sb to do, assigned task

questions.explanation: 在时装设计师的邀请下，Brown与她“合作（partnered with）”创作了连衣裙。易错点：误选A（求助于），两人是平等的受邀合作关系，并非单方面求助。
questions.supplement:
A(turned to)：语境句：When he was in trouble, he turned to his parents for help. 固定搭配：turn to sb for help, turn out
B(relied on)：语境句：The region has heavily relied on agriculture for centuries. 固定搭配：rely on, rely upon
C(partnered with)：语境句：Our school partnered with a local charity to raise funds. 固定搭配：partner with, business partner
D(went after)：语境句：The brave dog went after the thief without hesitation. 固定搭配：go after a dream, go after sb

section_2_word_form.passage:
The Great Wall was built over centuries by China's emperors in defense of their territory, and [56] for thousands of miles along China's historic northern border today.
The one thing most people "know" about the Great Wall — it is the only man-made structure [57] is visible from space — is probably not true. Since the Wall looks a lot like the stone and soil surrounding it, [58] is difficult to see it with the human eye even from low Earth orbit or to get it [59] in most orbital photos. However, this doesn't take away the wonder of this astonishing ancient structure.
The emperors of many Chinese dynasties throughout history instituted wall-building projects [60] the land from northern invasion(入侵). One [61] section of such an ancient wall in Shandong Province is made out of hard-packed soil and estimated to be about 2,500 years old. For centuries during the Warring States period, before China [62] together into one nation, such walls defended the borders. In the 17th century, the Wall became less important [63] a defense; however, it has preserved its symbolic [64], representing Chinese identity and culture.
Countless visitors view the Wall every year. It may be unlikely to be visible from space, [65] it is considered "an absolute masterpiece" on Earth.

questions.explanation: 句中and连接两个并列谓语，主语为The Great Wall，时间状语为today，故此处表述现在的情况，需用一般现在时，且主语为单数，故填stretches。易错点：受前文was built干扰而误填stretched。
questions.supplement: 正确形(stretches)：语境句：The vast desert stretches for thousands of miles. 固定搭配：stretch out, stretch for。原词stretch其它变形：stretched(adj. 伸展的), stretchy(adj. 有弹性的)

questions.explanation: 此处为定语从句，修饰先行词structure。当先行词被the only, the very等修饰时，关系代词只能用that，不能用which。易错点：误填which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that)：语境句：This is the only book that I want to read right now. 固定搭配：the only ... that, all that。

questions.explanation: 此处考察it作形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式短语to see it... or to get it...。句型：It is + adj. + to do sth。易错点：误填this或that。
questions.supplement: 正确形(it)：语境句：It is highly important to learn a foreign language. 固定搭配：make it clear, take it easy。

questions.explanation: 此处考察“get + 宾语 + 宾补”结构。宾语it（指代长城）与distinguish（辨认出）之间是动宾（被动）关系，故用过去分词作宾补，表示“使它被辨认出来”。易错点：误填distinguishing或to distinguish。
questions.supplement: 正确形(distinguished)：语境句：The unique design keeps the product distinguished from others. 固定搭配：distinguish A from B, be distinguished by。原词distinguish其它变形：distinguishable(adj.), distinguishing(adj.)

questions.explanation: 此处表示建造城墙项目的目的，“为了保护土地免受北方入侵”，故使用动词不定式作目的状语。易错点：误填protecting作定语，语境更强调目的。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to protect)：语境句：We should wear sunglasses to protect our eyes from the strong sunlight. 固定搭配：protect... from/against, environmental protection。原词protect其它变形：protection(n.), protective(adj.)

questions.explanation: 空处修饰名词section，作前置定语。exist常以现在分词形式existing作形容词，意为“现存的，现有的”。易错点：误填existed，exist为不及物动词，通常不用过去分词作前置定语表示“已存在的”。
knowledge_points: 非谓语动词转化形容词
questions.supplement: 正确形(existing)：语境句：The manager decided to improve the existing software system. 固定搭配：existing problems, currently existing。原词exist其它变形：existence(n.), existent(adj.)

questions.explanation: 在“before China [bring] together...”从句中，主语China与bring之间是被动关系，且该动作发生在过去的战国时期之后（历史事件），故用一般过去时的被动语态。易错点：误填brought或had been brought。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was brought)：语境句：The issue was brought to the public's attention yesterday. 固定搭配：bring together, bring about, bring up。原词bring其它变形：brought(pt./pp.), bringing(v.ing)

questions.explanation: 长城“作为”防御工事的重要性降低了。介词as意为“作为”，符合语境。易错点：由于缺乏词根提示，可能想不出合适的介词，误填for。
questions.supplement: 正确形(as)：语境句：She works as a volunteer teacher in a remote local school. 固定搭配：regard as, serve as, act as。

questions.explanation: 空前为形容词symbolic（象征性的），故此处需要填名词形式。significant的名词是significance。易错点：拼写错误或填错词性。
questions.supplement: 正确形(significance)：语境句：The scientific discovery is of great significance to medical research. 固定搭配：cultural significance, historical significance。原词significant其它变形：significantly(adv.), signify(v.)

questions.explanation: 前半句说“从太空不太可能看得见它”，后半句说“它被认为是地球上的绝对杰作”，前后语意存在明显的转折关系，故填连词but或yet。易错点：误填however，however作副词不能直接连接两个分句（除非有分号）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(but/yet)：语境句：The task was incredibly difficult, but he managed to finish it on time. 固定搭配：not only... but also, anything but。
